name: paseo-team
description: Paseo plugin that runs a coding task as a small team: a coordinator, a developer, and two cross-reviewing code reviewers behind a quality gate.
author: OliverWalker1122

scripts.format: prettier --write README.md README.zh-CN.md OVERVIEW.md CONTRIBUTING.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md paseo-plugin.json package.json tsconfig.json index.client.tsx index.server.ts "shared/**/*.ts" "server/**/*.ts" "client/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "tests/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.mjs" .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md README.zh-CN.md OVERVIEW.md CONTRIBUTING.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md paseo-plugin.json package.json tsconfig.json index.client.tsx index.server.ts "shared/**/*.ts" "server/**/*.ts" "client/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "tests/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.mjs" .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:plugin
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/check.test.ts tests/task-store.test.ts tests/quality-gate.test.ts tests/turn-observer.test.ts tests/handoff.test.ts tests/prompts.test.ts tests/client-ui.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
